name: UZH Kingfisher research quad (NeuroBEM / Agilicious), 4S
notes: The University of Zurich Robotics and Perception Group's 5-inch quad of the NeuroBEM and Agilicious papers: an Armattan Chameleon 6-inch frame with 5.1-inch props and a Jetson TX2 on board. Geometry, inertia, hover thrust and its Betaflight tune come from UZH's published model and logs; with them the simulator reproduces its logged flights (step response 26 / 22 ms against the real 28 / 22, docs/evidence/2026-10-21-neurobem-replay). Aerodynamic drag and collision are the Nazgul preset's estimates. Nothing here is endorsed by UZH.

wheelbase_mm.note: motor to motor across the diagonal, from the motor positions below (2 x sqrt(77.5^2 + 100^2))

motor_forward_mm.note: each motor ahead of / behind the centre (a stretched X on the Armattan Chameleon 6-inch frame)

motor_lateral_mm.note: each motor to the side of the centre

motor.note: Agilicious Table 2: 23x6 mm stator, 2400 kV, 758 W, 27.5 g

prop.note: Agilicious Table 2: 5.1 inch, 4.8 inch pitch, 5 g

prop_solidity.note: the Nazgul preset's estimate for 5-inch three-blade props; the 5148's chord is not published

prop_pitch_in.note: the prop is 4.8 inch pitch; the rotor inflow model's windmill curves (sim-core/0.8.0) take at most about 4.4 on a 5.1-inch prop, so 4.4; the thrust level is set by the hover fit (twr)

dry_mass_g.note: 752 g take-off weight minus the 199 g pack (the NeuroBEM website later gives 772 g; the logs were fitted with 752)

auw_g.note: NeuroBEM paper section IV; includes the Jetson TX2 compute unit (154 g)

twr.note: fitted so the model hovers at the logs' median 11 100-11 500 rpm (DShot rpm telemetry): 11 400 rpm; the model's static thrust is then 31.6 N, the paper's 'approximately 33 N' (4.5)

inertia_roll_pitch_kgm2.note: mean of roll and pitch (the per-axis values below are the ones used)

inertia_roll_kgm2.note: "identified from the real platform" (NeuroBEM paper section V)

motor_tau_ms.note: classic physics only; with rotor inflow the motor model spools in 23-24 ms (63 %), as measured on this quad (24-32 ms rise, 20-26 fall after 4 ms dead time, docs/evidence/2026-10-21-neurobem-replay)

motor_kappa_m.note: kappa 0.022 N m / N (torque / thrust) in UZH's model of this quad; higher than the Nazgul's 0.0136, with its 4.8-inch pitch

motor_idle.ref: NeuroBEM raw blackbox logs (https://rpg.ifi.uzh.ch/NeuroBEM.html), log header

rates.ref: NeuroBEM raw blackbox logs (https://rpg.ifi.uzh.ch/NeuroBEM.html), log header
rates.note: rc_rates 220/220/204, rates 0, rc_expo 0, rates_type BETAFLIGHT: linear, 440 deg/s on roll and pitch at full stick

pid_roll.ref: NeuroBEM raw blackbox logs (https://rpg.ifi.uzh.ch/NeuroBEM.html), log header

pid_pitch.ref: NeuroBEM raw blackbox logs (https://rpg.ifi.uzh.ch/NeuroBEM.html), log header

pid_yaw.ref: NeuroBEM raw blackbox logs (https://rpg.ifi.uzh.ch/NeuroBEM.html), log header

rpm_loaded_fraction.note: as the Nazgul preset (a 5-inch quad of the same class). loaded rpm / (KV * V) at full throttle on the stand: sets the full-throttle rotor speed, so with the TWR the prop's static thrust coefficient (0.18 in UIUC units; measured 5-inch three-blade props: 0.15-0.18), and the motor model's effective resistance (sim-core/0.8.0: 0.11 ohm, 1.5 x the 74 mOhm winding iFlight lists; the rest stands for the ESC and the motor's losses under load)

cda_horizontal_cm2.note: as the Nazgul preset (a 5-inch quad of the same class). side-on frame, air unit and pack

cda_vertical_cm2.note: as the Nazgul preset (a 5-inch quad of the same class). classic physics only: set so the top speed in the simulator is about 150 km/h (iFlight states 190 km/h); stands in for the props unloading at speed, which the classic model does not have

cda_vertical_inflow_cm2.note: as the Nazgul preset (a 5-inch quad of the same class). frame, pack and camera seen from above (owner agreed 150, 2026-10-18); with rotor inflow the props unload at speed themselves, so this is the frame's own drag

collider_duct_radius_mm.note: as the Nazgul preset (a 5-inch quad of the same class). open props: one sphere per prop zone

collider_duct_offset_mm.note: as the Nazgul preset (a 5-inch quad of the same class). reaches the prop tips (arm 84.5 mm + prop radius 65 mm)

collider_body_radius_mm.note: as the Nazgul preset (a 5-inch quad of the same class).

v_bounce_ms.note: as the Nazgul preset (a 5-inch quad of the same class).

v_crash_ms.note: as the Nazgul preset (a 5-inch quad of the same class). a 5-inch freestyle frame shrugs off more than a whoop

pack_resistance_per_cell_ohm.note: as the Nazgul preset (a 5-inch quad of the same class). 6S 1480 mAh freestyle pack, wiring and XT60 included

efficiency.note: as the Nazgul preset (a 5-inch quad of the same class). shaft power / pack power; 0.65 with the estimated kappa 0.012, raised with the measured kappa (sim-core/0.8.0) so the hover current, checked against iFlight's hover time, is unchanged

camera_uptilt_deg.note: as the Nazgul preset (a 5-inch quad of the same class). the mount adjusts 10-45 deg; freestyle pilots fly about 25-35

camera_fov_deg.note: as the Nazgul preset (a 5-inch quad of the same class). horizontal field of view of the simulated camera

throttle.note: as the Nazgul preset (a 5-inch quad of the same class).

rotor_drag_per_s.note: as the Nazgul preset (a 5-inch quad of the same class). momentum theory sqrt(g rho A_rotors / m) = 0.93 1/s times 0.55, the share Faessler et al. 2018 measured on an open-prop quad of the same size (0.24-0.54 1/s)

rotor_inertia_kgm2.note: as the Nazgul preset; with it the model spools in 23-24 ms (63 %), as measured on this quad (docs/evidence/2026-10-21-neurobem-replay)

wake_loss.note: as the Nazgul preset (a 5-inch quad of the same class). share of thrust lost at the worst point of a descent through the rotors' own wake (vortex-ring band of momentum theory); sim-core wake.ts

wake_shake.note: as the Nazgul preset (a 5-inch quad of the same class). turbulent roll/pitch torque in the wake, as a share of one rotor's thrust times the arm (rotor thrust fluctuates by tens of per cent in the vortex-ring state)
